root_cause.adapter: hypothesis_card_model_schema() answers anyOf [null, card]; the OpenClaw adapter structured-argument validator allowlist did not include anyOf, so every answer was refused with OPENCLAW_TOOL_ARGS_SCHEMA_MISMATCH (hosted: 109 of 112 paid calls, 0 cards)
root_cause.controller: extraction_tick_budget deferral is released via defer_budget(next_window=False) without deferred_since, and metrics()['deferred'] counted only budget_exhausted/attempts_deferred with deferred_since set, so retry_wait - deferred > 0 failed every tick on registry_sync

decisions.acceptance_1_option: adapter support, not a schema change: the model-facing schema stays nullable (anyOf [null, card]) and the semantic extraction schemas keep their allOf/if/then/else abstention conditional, so the provider side still receives the full contract. anyOf, allOf, if, then, else are validated for real; every subschema is held to the same keyword allowlist by unsupported_schema_keyword_paths() before any branch is tried, so an unsupported keyword in any branch is refused even when a sibling branch would match; schema-declaration faults inside a branch (malformed type/required/...) propagate instead of reading as a non-match. oneOf, not, format, $ref, patternProperties etc. still fail closed. An unknown type name is now a declaration error (was a value mismatch).
decisions.acceptance_1_scope_note: allOf/if/then/else were added beyond anyOf because acceptance 2 requires every schema sent to /structured (including the four semantic extraction schemas, which use allOf+if/then/else) to pass the adapter keyword check.
decisions.acceptance_3_option: prompt states the limit: ABSTENTION_REASON_MAX_CHARS = 200 is shared by the schema and the prompt line; an over-long reason stays a refusal on both adapter and jsonschema sides, never truncated
decisions.acceptance_4: PLANNED_DEFERRAL_REASONS (budget_exhausted, attempts_deferred, extraction_tick_budget) in distillation_worker.py is the one definition: defer_budget refuses any other reason and metrics() counts retry_wait rows whose last_error is in the set

tests.services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/tests/: real hypothesis_card_model_schema() and get_semantic_extraction_json_schema() for every ExtractionTaskType through the real adapter validator and jsonschema Draft7: valid card passes, abstained null card passes, missing required / extra field / non-object card refused, abstention_reason 200 ok and 201 refused, every client schema has no unsupported keyword, semantic if/then/else agrees with jsonschema
tests.services/source_ingestion/tests/test_dis: only extraction_tick_budget deferrals -> controller_status working; plus a real registry_sync retry_wait -> DistillationControllerError stage registry_sync
